1. Overview

title: You will be given a reference game as screenshots and/or a short video capture. Your task is to reproduce it as closely as possible — visually and in gameplay feel — inside a new Unity project, implementing 5 playable levels, and a webhook-triggered in-game event.

i.c: You will be given a reference game as screenshots and/or a short video capture. Your task is to reproduce it as closely as possible — visually and in gameplay feel — inside a new Unity project, implementing 5 playable levels, and a webhook-triggered in-game event.
2. What you will receive

title: A set of reference screenshots and/or a short video recording of the target game (a 2D/2.5D climbing game where a character scales obstacles, reacting to on-screen events).

i.c: A set of reference screenshots and/or a short video recording of the target game (a 2D/2.5D climbing game where a character scales obstacles, reacting to on-screen events).

title: Recreate the reference game in Unity, matching it as closely as possible on:

i.c: Recreate the reference game in Unity, matching it as closely as possible on:

title: Overall art direction: color palette, silhouette style, background layers/parallax, lighting/shading approach.

i.c: Overall art direction: color palette, silhouette style, background layers/parallax, lighting/shading approach.

title: Camera framing and behaviour (follow, zoom, screen shake if present in the reference).

i.c: Camera framing and behaviour (follow, zoom, screen shake if present in the reference).

title: UI layout: HUD, buttons, fonts/iconography style, menus (main menu, level select, pause, win/lose).

i.c: UI layout: HUD, buttons, fonts/iconography style, menus (main menu, level select, pause, win/lose).

title: Core gameplay loop and pacing of the climbing character as seen in the reference video.

i.c: Core gameplay loop and pacing of the climbing character as seen in the reference video.

i.c: Perfect pixel-matching is not expected — the goal is a convincing, professional-quality visual and functional match, not a 1:1 asset clone.
4. Required scope
4.1 Levels
Exactly 5 distinct, playable levels.

title: Each level must be completable from start to finish (clear win condition) and must be reachable from a level-select or sequential flow.

i.c: Each level must be completable from start to finish (clear win condition) and must be reachable from a level-select or sequential flow.

title: Levels should show visible progression (increasing difficulty, or distinct visual themes) consistent with what's shown in the reference material.

i.c: Levels should show visible progression (increasing difficulty, or distinct visual themes) consistent with what's shown in the reference material.
4.2 Character & controls

title: A climbing character with controls/mechanics matching the reference as closely as reasonably achievable in the time given.

i.c: A climbing character with controls/mechanics matching the reference as closely as reasonably achievable in the time given.

title: Basic states expected: idle, move/climb, fall or hit reaction, win/lose.

i.c: Basic states expected: idle, move/climb, fall or hit reaction, win/lose.
4.3 Art & assets — constraints

title: Only free-to-use Unity Asset Store / free asset packs (correctly licensed for this use), and/or AI-generated assets (images, sprites, sounds, music) are allowed.

i.c: Only free-to-use Unity Asset Store / free asset packs (correctly licensed for this use), and/or AI-generated assets (images, sprites, sounds, music) are allowed.

title: No help from an associate artist, illustrator, or any third-party human art contributor. All visual asset sourcing/creation must be done by the candidate alone.

i.c: No help from an associate artist, illustrator, or any third-party human art contributor. All visual asset sourcing/creation must be done by the candidate alone.

title: You may use free UI kits, free particle/VFX packs, free SFX libraries, and free fonts, as long as the license permits redistribution in this test.

i.c: You may use free UI kits, free particle/VFX packs, free SFX libraries, and free fonts, as long as the license permits redistribution in this test.

i.c: Basic SFX and/or music are expected if present in the reference; free or AI-generated only, same constraint as above.
5. Required feature — Webhook-triggered event

title: The build must run a local HTTP listener inside the game while playing, exposing:

i.c: The build must run a local HTTP listener inside the game while playing, exposing:
POST/GET
http://localhost:56789/bump

title: When this endpoint receives a request while a level is being played, the game must immediately trigger, full-screen and eye-catching:

i.c: When this endpoint receives a request while a level is being played, the game must immediately trigger, full-screen and eye-catching:

title: A burst of multiple boxing gloves (from any angle/direction, animated, at least 4–6 gloves) striking the climbing character.

i.c: A burst of multiple boxing gloves (from any angle/direction, animated, at least 4–6 gloves) striking the climbing character.

title: The effect must be clearly visible over the entire screen (not a small local effect) and must read as an obvious, punchy, comedic "hit" moment — think screen shake, impact flashes, glove sprites/particles, and a short SFX.

i.c: The effect must be clearly visible over the entire screen (not a small local effect) and must read as an obvious, punchy, comedic "hit" moment — think screen shake, impact flashes, glove sprites/particles, and a short SFX.

title: The event must not soft-lock or crash the game; after the animation the player must be able to keep playing normally.

i.c: The event must not soft-lock or crash the game; after the animation the player must be able to keep playing normally.
